app.name: DiiS
app.short_description: Nintendo DS and GBA emulator for Wii
app.long_description:
A homebrew Nintendo DS emulator for the Nintendo Wii with ARM7/ARM9 JIT recompilers, hardware-accelerated 3D and GBA slot-2 support.
Built by: Robert Hoffman
Based on the original DeSmuME Wii port by: Arikado, scanff, firnis, and baby.lueshi
